d: We are seeking a skilled Grid Operations Engineer / Power Distribution Specialist to manage electrical grid operations, power distribution networks, and system reliability. The role focuses on maintaining stable electricity supply, improving network efficiency, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and safety regulations.
Monitor and manage daily power grid operations and electrical distribution systems.
Conduct network inspections, fault analysis, and technical troubleshooting.
Coordinate preventive maintenance, equipment upgrades, and grid improvement projects.
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and regulatory requirements.
Support load management, system optimization, and power distribution planning.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in power distribution, grid operations, or electrical engineering.
Strong knowledge of substations, transformers, switchgear, and protection systems.
Familiarity with SCADA systems, grid monitoring, and power system analysis.
Excellent technical, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills
